name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities, including the MOTD and Hiera-provided utility packages, while providing custom types, functions, facts, and operational tasks.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys a Python application by managing its Git checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, protected environment file, database migrations, and systemd service.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures HAProxy with backend fragments, custom error pages, optional discovery, service and firewall management, statistics, TLS, and stick-table support.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs PostgreSQL using the PGDG repository, manages version-pinned packages including libpq-dev, and configures the database service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures Redis with password authentication, network binding, AOF persistence, memory limits, and an LRU policy, while querying PuppetDB for Redis-role discovery.

name: profile
description: Provides wrapper profiles that compose the base, application, HAProxy, and Redis implementations.

name: role
description: Combines profiles into node-level compositions for application, application-stack, HAProxy, and Redis cluster systems.
